name: City of Mount Vernon
gaps: Attachment 1 schedule is marked 'Amended 7-8-2009' (page dated 3-1-2013); no later amendment shown on the schedule
In R2-4.5, RMF-6.75, RMF-10 and RMF-15 one-family dwellings follow R1-4.5 rules (§ 267-17); the district rows hold the district's own schedule values and the R1-4.5 values are given in notes
FAR set only for R1-7 (0.35); no FAR for other residence districts
Lot depth not set; 'Lot width and frontage' recorded as both width and frontage
MVW-T / MVW-T(NC): Detached dwelling building type sets side yards of 2 ft (one) and 5 ft (both) as written; no corner-side yard
WVW-H (NC) (MVW-H(NC)): no one-family use; rear/side 'common lot line' 0 ft recorded; tower-on-podium standards not recorded
No local steep-slope law and no accessory dwelling unit provision found
R1-TH, RMF-SC, UR-PUD, PUD-2, TOD-1, DTOAD and H districts not covered (not county residential codes)

wetlands.summary: § 267-14F: no building or structure within 25 ft of the boundary of any tidal or freshwater wetland (piers, docks and boat facilities excepted). No separate wetlands permit chapter found.

steep_slopes.summary: No steep-slope regulation found in the City Code.

trees.summary: Ch. 252 (2022): permit from the Department of Public Works to remove any tree on private property 10 in. DBH or larger (non-emergency); replacement may be required.

stormwater.summary: Ch. 226: SWPPP for land development/redevelopment disturbing 1 acre or more (or part of a larger common plan); Planning Board projects reviewed under its standards.

adu.summary: No accessory apartment / ADU provision found in Ch. 267.

general.accessory_structures: § 267-13A: no structure in required yards except decks/terraces under 18 in. high (3 ft from side/rear lines), pools, fences, porches/steps, and minor accessory structures in side/rear yards at least 3 ft from any lot line. Accessory buildings max 1 story / 12 ft (§ 267-14M).
general.pools: § 267-14C: at least 5 ft from all lot lines, not in the front yard; 6 ft fence and evergreen screening; above-ground pools max 48 in. high.
general.notes: Corner lots: owner picks the front; the secondary front yard minimum is R1-7 18 ft, R1-4.5 12 ft, R1-3.6/R2-4.5 8 ft, RMF-6.75 10 ft, RMF-10 15 ft, RMF-15 20 ft (§ 267-13B). Pre-7/1/1963 undersized lots may build with proportionally reduced side/rear yards in one-/two-family districts (§ 267-12D).

WVW-H (NC).notes: County code 'WVW-H (NC)' = MVW-H(NC). One-family and two-family dwellings are prohibited; only multifamily apartment and tower-on-podium building types allowed. Values are for the Multifamily apartment type: common lot line setback 0 ft or 10 ft if provided (recorded as side/rear 0); 30 ft from a lot line abutting RMF-10/15; 200 sf usable open space per unit.
